summary: This is a static single-image task, so PROC-CT-004 applies and replaces the multi-view criteria of PROC-CT-001. PROC-CT-002 concerns crazing or cracks, and no linear feature was found. obs_01 shows a localized rough, grainy, bright-speckled patch in the upper-right corner that differs from the surrounding texture. The approved reference (obs_02) was fetched and has no such patch (matches_reference=false). This matches the 'Rough' example in CT-4, so it is a suspected defect. The lack of surface discontinuity is irrelevant because CT-1 does not apply.
